linked_titles: Tokenization crashes when split string has more than one character
commit_message:
fix: Support multicharacter separators in text tokenization

Tokenizer.fit_on_texts crashes with a ValueError when split contains
multiple characters because the two-argument maketrans form requires
source and replacement strings of equal length.

Use dictionary-based translation on Python 3 to map each filtered
character to the full separator. For Python 2 byte strings, use
replacement for multicharacter separators while preserving the existing
Unicode and single-character translation paths. This allows punctuation
and explicit separators to produce the intended tokens across versions.

Add regression tests for multicharacter separators with both ordinary
and Unicode text.

Fixes #9538
